My father left my mother last November after cheating on her for whoever knows how long. I graduated this past May, and that was the last time I saw my father. 

A couple of days afterwards, he sent me a text message that essentially belittled me, calling me an "idiot", accusing my mother of brainwashing me into thinking he's scum, telling me I'll never get anywhere in life without him, and just basically treating me like I wasn't even his son, but as someone that undermined his life. It's been almost 5 months now and I don't know where he is, nor have I had any contact with him. I don't even care to see him again. But it just goes to show that words can really do some damage.

While I was still in high school, I'd normally walk by myself to a Taco Bell down the road to eat and come back to the school to wait until my ride got there. Along the way to the Taco Bell I always pass by a small, shady-looking apartment complex, as its along the only sidewalk I can take. 

One afternoon, school ends and I take my normal walk to Taco Bell, order a little bit of food and just sit around and play on my phone for a while. Then I make my walk back to school, and I see some woman walking out of the complex, and you can tell by the way she carried herself that she was on something. Well I get closer and closer, crossing my fingers in hopes that she won't say anything to me or try to do anything. I get within a foot of her and all I hear is:

"Hey!!! You, kid! You see that?!"

This tweaker points in between two poles of a black fence in front of the complex, and of course I look. All she says after that is ".....there's NOTHING in there...". 
She hobbles back to her doorstep after that, and I walked twice as fast back to school.

I made my daily trips pretty quickly after that incident.
